thesis: The page is the door's riveted nameplate read aloud: every section stamps a reading onto a zinc plate, and the hero asks what broke and stamps the answer before it ever pitches.

signature.name: Riveted Data Plate
signature.summary: Brushed zinc rectangle with four rivet heads, stamped readout rows (LABEL dotted leader VALUE), a blank fill-in field for what gets measured at your door, and a cycle meter whose needle advances with --sw-p. Hero plate receives the finder answer; the spring story plate counts cycles until the coil snaps; every service and the parts sheet carry a small plate; reviews become readings; the footer is the company nameplate.

palette.family: Galvanized Zinc + Plate Black + Hazard Yellow + Stamp Blue

layoutMoves: 50/50 split whose seam is crossed by the riveted plate
dense parts-sheet ledger rows with dotted leaders
1:1 spring drawn edge to edge across the viewport
margin column of stamped serials (CC-01..CC-08) on desktop

motion.intro: Hero plate digits roll in odometer-style (600ms, 40ms stagger) and the cycle meter needle sweeps to 0; text readable from first paint.
stories: count: a 1:1 SVG torsion spring stretches across the screen while its plate counts cycles 0 to 10,000 (typical standard rating), then a gap opens in the coil, a 120ms shake and a drawn bang line
motion.hover: plates lift 2px and their rivets catch a light (inset highlight shifts), 200ms
